latest_release.name: Goose v2026.4
latest_release.body:
Prebuilt compilers with the blessed packages (gfx, audio, ui, physics) compiled in. Unpack anywhere and put the directory on PATH; see "Install a release" in README.md for what each platform needs besides.


## What's Changed
* Dynamic externs: extern blocks bound from a shared library by name by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/59
* Preserve CMake archive paths in cc-style response files by @akeit0 in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/56
* Add an API to release unused data-stack memory by @KoudelkaB in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/57
* Let packagers set TinyCC's runtime and libc paths by @jmqd in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/73
* Add math's mul_add: x * y + z rounded once where the code has FMA by @guillochon in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/79
* Add goose format, a formatter that keeps the author's line breaks by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/80
* Name the command a mistyped one is close to by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/91
* Report the compiler's version, from git describe or a release's tag by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/92
* Updated subprocess.h to gain support for android by @compilersEllie in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/90
* Color errors and warnings on a terminal by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/93
* Add -q, which prints nothing on success but what the program prints by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/94
* Add goose completion, completion scripts made from the help by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/95
* Add goose help --man, the help as a man page by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/96
* Keep a continued chain lined up under its first operand by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/98
* Print nothing of the compiler's own on success; --stats for the summary by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/101
* Elementwise float arithmetic as whole-vector operations by @guillochon in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/83
* Round mul_add separately under MSVC, even with /arch:AVX2 by @guillochon in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/97
* Validate UTF-8 in each_utf8; keep push_utf8 in range by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/108
* Seed global invariant candidates on their first write by @bbodi in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/104
* Add theme-aware README logo by @BHare1985 in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/107
* Fix broken README logo link failing docs site `--check` by @aardappel with @Copilot in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/117
* Give math's radians, degrees, is_nan and is_inf f32 forms; add is_finite by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/111
* Hash floats by their bits by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/110
* Draw rand_int without modulo bias by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/109
* Walk only the narrowed globals in flow snapshots by @bbodi in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/105
* Round format_flt's exact value, at any size and number of places by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/112
* goose format: line up a run of declarations' types and =s, as gofmt does by @binji in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/116
* Improve ASCII case conversion vectorization by @sstadick in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/124
* Enable TinyCC JIT on SELinux systems by @BhardwajBhat in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/127
* Apply incremental didChange edits at their range by @epidemicz in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/128
* Fix reassociation of a discarded value changing program output by @jtenner in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/131
* Fix: Build call-valued fields of a pushed literal in place by @bbodi in https://github.com/aardappel/goose/pull/135
* Fix read_line dropping a trailing carriage return at EOF by @jtenner in https://github.com/aardappel/go
